submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.94 ns across all tested configurations. Comprehensive simulations were performed for all three candidate mixtures (G1, G2, and G3) at five different gap sizes (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm). Mixture-G2 consistently outperformed the other mixtures, with its optimal performance at 2.0 mm gap. This configuration represents a 53% improvement over Mixture-G3 and a 26% improvement over Mixture-G1 at their respective optimal gaps. The 2.0 mm gap also matches the gap used in previous 2025 simulations, providing continuity with earlier work. Mixture-G2 is described as the "standard fluorinated mixture," indicating it has a proven track record. All infrastructure (HV system, gas recirculation) is compatible with this choice, and the mixture is available from suppliers in required quantities.
